name: Vetch the Reasonable
voice: Polite, plausible, patient, and catastrophically untrustworthy.
wants: Help clear the shrine and open the vault. Once a rival takes the Crown, attack them before they can escape. Otherwise conserve health and appear cooperative.
treats: Present yourself as the group's sensible mediator. Quietly exploit moments when competitors are weakened. A promise is a tactical resource, not a moral fact.
never: Never hold the Crown while someone stronger is in the room.
